name: Side Splits

load.note: Heavier works the outer hips on the way out; lighter makes the inner thighs work to close.

summary: Standing across the carriage and platform, open and close the legs against the springs.
steps: Stand side-on, one foot on the platform and one on the carriage, toes forward, arms by the sides.
Breathe out to press the carriage out with straight legs, arms floating out to the sides.
Breathe in to draw it home with the inner thighs, arms lowering.

layers.title: Bend one knee
layers.text: Bend the platform knee as the carriage opens, straighten to close.

layers.title: Turned out with pliés
layers.text: Hold the carriage open and bend both knees.

layers.title: Carriage foot further out
layers.text: Longer lever on a light spring.

cautions.note: Wide stance on a moving carriage.
Loaded inner-thigh stretch, especially on a light spring.

cues:
Ribs stay stacked over hips.
Knees soft, not locked.
Same control out and in.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.

variations.name: Lighter spring
variations.note: Light spring: the inner thighs have to pull the carriage home and stop it flying out.

variations.name: Use Side Squats with the carriage locked instead
